notes:
Run 2026-10-22 23:15 UTC to 2026-10-23 00:50 UTC (date field is the task day) on a 4-vCPU / 15 GB shared cloud VM, so absolute timings are noisy; ratios are the useful signal. grit = main at the commit above (release build, 0.5.16, built with rustc 1.99.0); git = system git 2.43.0; baseline = v0.5.0 release binary (grit-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, `grit 0.5.0`). GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM were isolated for all runs (the VM's global config enables core.fsmonitor, commit signing and rewrites URLs, which would skew git); a minimal user.name/email config was used instead. No repo code was touched; unmodified grit, grit-bench and grit-http-server release binaries from main were used.
Harness: `grit-bench daily` was run once per scenario (`--only <id>`, always with `--baseline-grit`, which only applies to headline rows); if that invocation failed (a baseline failure aborts the run) it was retried once without the baseline. v0.5.0 cannot run the blame, stash, log (--limit/--json), pull/rebase and push/force-with-lease headline commands, so those rows have baseline=null with baseline_note (not substituted). Runs per tool are in each row (`runs`, 3 to 20 timed runs after warmup, policy default). stddev_ms is null everywhere: the daily runner reports medians only. max_rss_kb is the peak RSS of the timed process tree. Fixtures: git.git at v2.47.0, small, synth-10k and synth-100k were pre-generated with `grit-bench fixtures prepare` (stopped after those: the unrelated synth-l fixture generation was spinning for 10+ minutes and was killed, partial synth-l dir removed); many-refs, big-blobs, deep-tree and deep-history fixtures were built on demand by their scenarios. The repos block is unchanged from 2026-10-21 (same generators; file/ref counts re-checked with `grit-bench fixtures list`).
Scenario set: every executable id in grit-bench's daily registry that I could find (112 ids, excluding the `test/*` and `future/*` harness self-test ids). New since 2026-10-21: add/dry-run@synth-10k, add/patch-file@synth-10k, add/update@synth-100k, branch/rename@many-refs, commit/dry-run@synth-10k, fetch/deepen@git-git, fetch/dry-run@git-git, fetch/one-branch@git-git, pull/check@git-git, pull/rebase@synth-10k, push/force-with-lease@git-git, push/refspec@git-git. log/json-100, pull/rebase and push/force-with-lease also carry headline=true (grit-bench marks them headline) in addition to the 17 required headline scenarios.
Noise re-runs: compared with daily/latest.json of 2026-10-21 (grit/git time ratio more than 20% worse, or peak-RSS ratio more than 30% worse). Re-ran each of these 3 more times (4 samples per tool; the reported median_ms and max_rss_kb are the median of the four per-sample medians/peaks; per-row `rerun` records the sample count and the first-pass grit/git ratio): add/modified@synth-10k (mem), diff/worktree@synth-10k (mem), push/incremental@git-git, diff/staged@deep-tree, diff/staged@synth-100k, reflog/list@synth-10k, shortlog/ahead@git-git, show/head@big-blobs, status/dirty@small. Outcome: all nine reproduced (none was noise): diff/staged@deep-tree is 12.7x git (4.2x yesterday), reflog/list@synth-10k 1.5x (1.0x yesterday), diff/staged@synth-100k 2.4x (1.95x), grit peak RSS is 1.8x to 2.8x git on add/modified and diff/worktree at synth-10k. Several rows that were flagged yesterday as regressions improved a lot today: gc/default@synth-10k is 2.8x git (43.5x yesterday), show/head@git-git 2.4x (6.5x), bundle/create@synth-10k 3.5x (13x), while diff/staged@deep-tree got worse (see above). fetch/pull/push headline rows still show grit far faster than git (and v0.5.0 takes 40 to 80 s on these); push/incremental@git-git has git at ~1.6 s versus grit at ~9 ms, which I did not independently verify beyond yesterday's fetch spot check, so treat that single row with caution.
Failures (kept in the report with grit=null and an error): branch/rename@many-refs (harness prepare step exits 128 before any timing), pull/check@git-git (grit `pull --check` takes minutes per run at 100% CPU, scenario killed after ~12 min), push/incremental-http@git-git (grit push over HTTP did not finish within 600 s; same symptom as the last two days with the 1500 s cap; I lowered the per-scenario cap to 600 s on this run to fit the 2 h budget and did not retry timeouts), push/refspec@git-git (harness correctness check: push rejected as non-fast-forward before timing), repack/full@git-git (did not finish within 600 s; yesterday it failed with a false SHA-1 collision report). For all five, neither tool has a number. Observed side effect: during fetch/incremental-http the grit-http-server process grew to about 5 GB RSS. Fixed from yesterday: fsck/full@git-git and worktree/add@synth-10k now complete.
